messages:
zoe: quick flag - saw a parity mismatch between Node and Python SDKs when using function-calls + JSON mode + auth-refresh header. Starter sample hit a bad loop for a partner. details below.

andre: ugh. what happened?

zoe: repro (mini):
1) starter-app in JSON mode, function_call -> proxy tool that may return 401 and a `x-refresh-token` header for refresh
2) Node SDK sees header and attempts token-refresh flow automatically, replays call; Python SDK treats 401 as terminal and surfaces it
3) however when the function output schema is strict, Node's refresh-path double-parses the function response and sometimes emits a malformed JSON string which trips schema validator and triggers a retry loop in runtime

snippet sent to model:```json
{"model":"gpt-prod","mode":"json","function_call":{"name":"proxy_check","arguments_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"q":{"type":"string"}}}}}
```

logs (Node sample):```
[2026-03-24T08:15:01Z] INFO tool-proxy: responded 401 + x-refresh-token
[2026-03-24T08:15:01Z] INFO sdk-node: attempting refresh flow
[2026-03-24T08:15:02Z] WARN parser: function output appears double-encoded string
[2026-03-24T08:15:02Z] ERR schema: validation failed - expected object
[2026-03-24T08:15:02Z] INFO retrying request attempt=1
```

sophie: hmm the runtime should treat schema validation failures from function outputs as non-transient. If the client retries, it just amplifies the problem. Why is Node doing an automatic refresh?

andre: we recently added a parity change to have SDKs auto-refresh when `x-refresh-token` present to match runtime behavior. apparently Node's refresh flow mutates the streaming buffer and ends up wrapping the function JSON in quotes in the reconstituted chunk. python's path doesn't have that bug.

zoe: immediate mitigation: set env var `REDWOOD_SDK_DISABLE_AUTO_REFRESH=true` in the starter sample to force client to surface the 401. That unblocks the customer. I pushed the sample patch to the starter repo.

ops-bot: CI: starter-samples/test-sample-proxy failed on `jsonmode-auth-refresh` (https://ci/c/12999) :red_circle:

ryan: plan: Andre will revert the auto-refresh parity change in Node SDK and replace it with an explicit opt-in flag `autoRefreshOnHeader`. Sophie will add a runtime guard so schema validation failures from function outputs are not retried server-side. Also add a cross-SDK integration test in starter-samples that simulates 401+refresh header + strict schema.

andre: opened PRs: https://repo/rw/node-sdk/pull/812 (revert + opt-in) and https://repo/rw/starter-samples/pull/99 (env var + repro). tagging @sophie for runtime change.

zoe: thanks. also added a tiny FAQ note in starter-samples README explaining the `REDWOOD_SDK_DISABLE_AUTO_REFRESH` workaround for partners who hit it during onboarding.

ryan: timeline - small patch release for Node SDK after green CI (24-36h). runtime fix planned for next minor release. will coordinate changelog and support communication.

sophie: once Node patch is cut I'll update the parity doc so we don't reintroduce this silently. good catch, zoe. :thumbsup:
